# ssrf

Go Reference Go version Mutation

ssrf keeps your Go service's outbound requests off private networks and cloud metadata endpoints, by checking URLs before you fetch and every address at connect time.

It replaces the URL checks and custom dialer you would otherwise write around `net/http`, and it hands back a plain `*http.Transport` and `CheckRedirect` function. At run time it uses the standard library and one dependency, runesafe by the same author, to clean untrusted text in its log lines. It needs Go 1.27.2 or later and is licensed under Apache-2.0.
